timeline.claim: A later five-minute bar closed above the upper OMG boundary after the first bar failed to qualify.

claims.label: CONTEMPORANEOUS_CLOSE_AND_CONFIRMATION
claims.claim: The room rejected the first non-qualifying bar, then entered calls only after a later close and one-minute confirmation.
claims.disconfirming_evidence_required: Exact boundary, synchronized bars, immutable signal log, executable option fills, MFE/MAE, and all comparable setups.

claims.label: BOUNDED_EXIT_BEFORE_EXTENSION
claims.claim: Three parallel call positions exited at their bounded objectives before price extended substantially higher.
claims.disconfirming_evidence_required: Executable bid paths, quantities, slippage, fees, MFE/MAE, trailing-exit comparator, and aggregate exposure.

claims.label: COUNTERTREND_PUT_WITHOUT_PRICE_STOP
claims.claim: A countertrend 615-put position entered after strong all-time-high expansion with a target but no audible maximum loss and remained unresolved.
claims.disconfirming_evidence_required: Exact stop, size, option path, later exit, broker order, and comparable countertrend trades.

claims.label: CALENDAR_RECOVERY_THESIS
claims.claim: Put holders were advised to wait for a later quarter-end reversal rather than manage from a present price invalidation.
claims.disconfirming_evidence_required: Later market and option path, exact entries, price invalidations, all quarter-end cases, and broker exits.

claims.label: POST_ASSET_DATE_CONFLICT
